Cleveland's
Pride Hour

We are bringing Ohio Pride Hour to the Leather Stallion Saloon during Sunday Funday, the tea dance Cleveland has been showing up for on that patio for years. Your contribution is your RSVP, and it powers LGBTQ+ political action across Ohio. Regular bar hours, open patio, everyone welcome.
